Hi Lindsey —

Thanks for the clear sheet, that helps. Short answers up front: yes, we can offer bespoke deletion timelines and provide a deletion certificate; there are a couple of detail points we'll need to align on for the order form. I've attached a draft SLA/order form language (RNWD-SLA-DRAFT-v1.docx) with three options:

A) Standard: deletion of primary runtime data within 30 calendar days; backups/snapshots eligible for purge on their regular cadence (explicitly documented).
B) Accelerated: certified deletion of primary data and any hot backups within 7 calendar days after request; we provide a signed deletion certificate and a machine-auditable event log.
C) Litigation hold carveout: ability to suspend deletion for defined legal holds (customer-managed hold ID), in which case data will be withheld and invoiced until release.

Edge-cases and notes:
- Long-term archives (cold storage) are treated as separate buckets — accelerations for cold storage carry additional data-transfer and processing costs.
- Certified deletion includes key rotation + cryptographic proof of key destruction for encrypted volumes; we can append an HSM-backed key-rotation certificate.
- For snapshots spanning multiple customers we can provide a scoped deletion process but full purging may require a short coordination window (we call this a "scoped purge workflow").

Can you confirm whether Cairn's requirement is: (i) 14 days for all customer data including snapshots, or (ii) 7 days for primary data + 180 days litigation hold for regulated cohorts? Once we have the target windows we'll map them to option A/B/C and surface any pricing delta.

I copied Marissa (contracts) to help with language and Vivek (product) for feasibility/implementation notes.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if useful.

Best,

Tessa —

Thanks, the draft is helpful. A few clarifications from our side (procurement + legal):

- For regulated patient cohorts we need a) certified deletion of primary and hot backups within 7 calendar days and b) an option to trigger a certified deletion of cold archives within 30 calendar days (we understand there will be additional costs).
- Litigation hold: we require the ability to issue a hold for up to 180 days that suspends deletion; the hold must be reversible by our legal team.
- Certificate format: Procurement requests that deletion certificates include (i) deletion timestamp, (ii) list of affected resource IDs, (iii) hash of the export (if applicable), and (iv) signature from an authorized Redwood representative.
- For partial deletions (e.g., subsetted patient cohort), can you describe the scoped purge workflow? We want to ensure you don't accidentally impact nearby datasets.

Next steps: please send the RNWD SLA with the 7-day accelerated option filled in and a redline for the litigation hold clause. Also please add a short CSV mapping (data_handback_matrix.csv) that shows how we return exported data and the expected format.

Procurement will want a DocuSign-ready version after redlines.

Best,
Lindsey
